---
title: "Publications"
---

```{r}
library(magrittr)
library(data.table)
library(gt)
library(scholar)

pubs <- fread("../publications/publications.csv")

id <- 'e1whCCAAAAAJ'
l <- scholar::get_profile(id)

make_table <- function(dat_in, width_n = 40){
  
  width_rule <- rlang::new_formula(
    lhs = rlang::expr(n),
    rhs = width_n
  )
  
  
  dat_in[, .(n = paste0(rev(.I), ".") ,  ref_link)] %>% 
    gt() %>% 
    fmt_markdown(columns = everything()) %>% 
    tab_options(
      table.width = pct(100),
      column_labels.hidden = TRUE,
      table.border.top.style = "hidden",
      table_body.hlines.style =  "hidden",
      table_body.border.bottom.style = "hidden"
    ) %>% 
    cols_width(
      .list = list(width_rule)
    ) %>% 
    cols_align(
      align = c("left"),
      columns = everything()
    ) %>% 
    tab_style(
      style = cell_text(v_align = "top"),
      locations = cells_body(columns = n)
    ) %>% 
    tab_style(style = cell_fill(color = "white"),
              locations = cells_body())
  
}

```

Last updated: `r format(Sys.Date(), '%d.%m.%Y')`

Altogether, **`r nrow(pubs)`** publications with **`r l$total_cites`** cites, h-index of **`r l$h_index`**, and i10-index of **`r l$i10_index`** in Google Scholar.

## Peer-Reviewed Scientific Articles

```{r}
pubs[aka_category =="a"] %>% 
  make_table()

```

```{r}
pubs[aka_category =="b"] %>%
```
